# Test fixtures

## `legacy_v7_vectors.json`

Ground-truth data for the SeePass 7.x importer (`src/legacy.rs`).

It was generated by a small C# program that copies `GenerateHash`, `FinalKey`,
and `Encrypt` from the 7.x sources (`legacy/PasswordManager/.../Crypto.cs`)
unchanged, then ran them on .NET Framework 4.8 with `Encoding.Default` = code
page 1252. Each case has:

* `user`, `pass`, `pim`: the 7.x login,
* `settings`: what 7.x wrote to `settings.config` (the `pim` hash chain,
  `pim_salt`, and the `encryptVector` string),
* `rows`: the Base64 ciphertext for each `data` table column, plus the
  plaintext it should decrypt to.

The last case uses a hand-picked IV with bytes that code pages map in odd ways
(`0x00`, `0x81`, `0x8D`, `0x8F`, `0x90`, `0x9D`, ...) and non-ASCII
credentials. Non-ASCII characters are lossy in 7.x's `Encoding.ASCII`
hashing, so this case checks that we reproduce that loss exactly.

The rows also cover Romanian diacritics, an emoji, quotes, and empty strings.

The integration test rebuilds a real 7.x folder (`settings.config` +
SQLite `data.db`) and an exported `data.zip` from these values.
